packageRules.description: Never automerge without the image build gate passing. Renovate holds automerge until all branch checks are green (ignoreTests defaults to false); this makes that explicit and opt-in per-manager below.
OS base image tags (fedora-bootc / fedora-minimal / golang): allow minor+patch, but a major is a distro/toolchain jump — hold for a human. v45 = rawhide, which is why this exists.
ollama is 0.x: every minor can rework the build (v0.32 dropped the CPU/Vulkan CMake presets). Treat minor+major as breaking — build must pass and a human must merge.
